name: zephyrisle/flarum-zai-bot
description: ZAI Bot - An AI-powered bot for Flarum with personality presets, tools (user info, search, files, stickers, likes), and extension integrations.

suggest.flarum/messages: Enables AI replies in private messages.
suggest.ramon/verified: Enables user verification status in AI context and user info tool.
suggest.ramon/stickers: Enables sticker search and listing tool.
suggest.flarum/likes: Enables post like info query tool.
suggest.fof/user-bio: Enables user bio display in profile and context.
suggest.fof/upload: Enables viewing user uploaded files (text and images).
suggest.datlechin/flarum-birthdays: Enables user birthday display in profile and context.
suggest.forumaker/profile-cover: Enables user cover image display in profile info.
